
```{=html}
<style>
/* Mobile-first layout: stacks items, image on top naturally */
  .profile-header-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2rem;
    /* border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); */
  }

  .profile-image-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end; /* Right-justifies the credit text */
  }

  .profile-photo {
    width: 350px;
    height: 350px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 5%;
    /* border: 3px solid var(--accent-main); */
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* New style for the photo credit */
  .profile-credit {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin: 8px 0 0 0;
    max-width: 200px; /* Constrains text width to match the photo */
    text-align: right;
  }

  /* Desktop layout: Side-by-side, swaps the order */
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .profile-header-container {
      flex-direction: row;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .profile-info {
      flex: 1;
      order: 1; /* Forces text to the left */
      min-width: 250px;
    }
    .profile-image-block {
      order: 2; /* Forces image to the right */
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
  }

  .profile-info {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 250px;
  }
  .profile-fullname {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: var(--fw-bold);
    color: var(--text-main);
    margin: 0 0 5px 0;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .profile-position {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
    color: var(--accent-main);
    margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  }
  .profile-affiliations {
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin: 0 0 15px 0;
  }
  .profile-affil-link {
    color: var(--text-main);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-color: var(--accent-main);
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
  }
  .profile-affil-link:hover {
    color: var(--accent-hover);
  }
  .profile-divider {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin: 0 5px;
  }
  .profile-short-desc {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin: 0;

  }
</style>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

meta <- rmarkdown::metadata
title      <- meta$name_title %||% ""
first_name <- meta$name_first %||% ""
last_name  <- meta$name_last %||% ""
if (title != "" | is.null(title)) {title <- str_squish(paste0(title, "<br>"))}
full_name  <- str_squish(paste(title, first_name, last_name))

position   <- meta$position %||% "" 
short_desc <- meta$description_short %||% ""
img_path   <- meta$profile_picture %||% ""

# Extract credit safely (returns empty string if missing)
credit_raw <- if (is.null(meta[["profile_picture_credit"]])) "" else meta[["profile_picture_credit"]]
credit_html <- if (credit_raw != "") sprintf('<p class="profile-credit">&copy; %s</p>', credit_raw) else ""

affil_html <- ""
if (!is.null(meta$affiliation)) {
  affil_html <- purrr::map_chr(meta$affiliation, \(x) {
    name <- x$name %||% ""
    url  <- x$url %||% ""
    
    if (url != "") {
      sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" class="profile-affil-link">%s</a>', url, name)
    } else {
      name
    }
  }) %>% paste(collapse = " <span class='profile-divider'>&bull;</span> ")
}

# HTML Generation: Image block comes first for mobile, CSS swaps it on desktop
html_out <- sprintf('
<div class="profile-header-container">
<div class="profile-image-block">
<img src="%s" alt="Profile Picture of %s" class="profile-photo">
%s
</div>
<div class="profile-info">
<h2 class="profile-fullname">%s</h2>
<p class="profile-position">%s</p>
<div class="profile-affiliations">%s</div>
<p class="profile-short-desc">%s</p>
</div>
</div>
', 
img_path, full_name, credit_html, full_name, position, affil_html, short_desc)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
cat("```{=html}\n")
cat(html_out)
cat("\n```\n")
```
